In compliance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 (“Act”), the rules made thereunder, and the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“Listing Regulations”), as amended from 
time to time, please find enclosed the Integrated Annual Report, Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report

These documents are being circulated to shareholders through electronic mode whose e -mail addresses are

communication to shareholders whose e-mail addresses are not registered with the Company/DPs, providing a
